s07.c1.en: Machines sample the world too: their sensors are read many times per second.

s07.c2.en: A 900 Hz vibration read 1000 times per second looks like a slow 100 Hz wave.

s07.c3.en: So engineers filter out what is too fast, then sample more than twice as fast.

s07.c4.en: And a strobe light uses aliasing on purpose, to freeze fast machines for inspection.
